description: This file defines classes, enums, and functions related to HTTP/WebSocket request handling within the WPEFramework Web namespace. It includes request parsing, serialization, MIME type handling, and request metadata management.

classes.name: IBody
classes.description: Interface for request/response bodies supporting serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: Signature
classes.description: Represents a cryptographic signature with hash type and value.

classes.name: Authorization
classes.description: Represents an authorization token with type and token string.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP/WebSocket request with methods for parsing, serialization, and managing request data.

methods.name: MIMETypeAndEncodingForFile
methods.description: Determines MIME type and encoding for a given file path.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the request into a byte stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into a request object.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts a request object to its string representation.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Parses a string to populate a request object.
